description: This file defines the interface ILocalStore for a local storage component within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares virtual functions for opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entry counts, getting entries, removing entries, and adding entries.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface for local storage operations, supporting open, create table, set limit, get entries count, get entries, remove entries, and add entry functions.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the local store at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table within the local store.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries for a specific table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table starting from a specific index up to a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from start index to end index in a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a table in the local store.
